passage.title: Transcript — Shopping survey
passage.text:
Good morning, I'm carrying out a survey about shopping in Broadbeach. Could I start with your name?

Yes, it's Martyn Hale.

And how did you travel to the town centre today?

By bike — I usually cycle in.

What have you come into town for today?

Three things, actually. I've been to the bank, I'm looking for a new phone, and I'm collecting my watch — it was being repaired.

Which day do you usually shop?

Saturday, when the market is on.

What do you think of the shops here?

The service is excellent. But there are too many places selling shoes, and I'd like more places to buy books.

And the new out-of-town shopping centre?

I like the parking best — it's free. But I think the cinema is unnecessary; we already have one in town.
